about: Georgia's outline, its 12 regions (Georgian law: Abkhazia and the Tskhinvali region are part of Georgia, drawn as no separate entity) and a gazetteer, projected for the where scene. Built by tools/build_georgia_map.py; tt_shorts/geo.py reads it. Its OpenStreetMap layers are in georgia-detail.json and tbilisi.json (ODbL).

sources.regions: OCHA COD-AB Georgia (data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-geo), source: National Statistics Office of Georgia, CC BY-IGO 3.0
sources.cut: geoBoundaries GEO ADM2 2007 (public domain): the Akhalgori line splitting the provisional unit
sources.places: assets/maps/georgia-places.csv: coordinates from Wikidata (CC0), QIDs in each place's q
sources.rivers: Natural Earth 10m rivers and lake centerlines + its Europe supplement (public domain)
sources.osm: OpenStreetMap (ODbL): the layers of georgia-detail.json and tbilisi.json
